description: Hi, I am a Computer Science student at Sir Syed University, Pakistan. I have also completed a Software Development course from Aptech. I am good at coding, web development, and storytelling. I want to join this team for Abandoned but not Forgotten challenge. I can help with building website, presentation, and story. I will work virtually and on time.
summary: Abandoned but not Forgotten is a project that finds abandoned places and gives them a new purpose. Many old buildings, schools, and empty lands are left unused, but they still have value. We developed a simple idea using NASA Earth data and maps to find these places and show how they can be reused for community, nature, and learning. Our project addresses the challenge by turning waste into opportunity. It is important because it saves resources, protects the environment, and helps communities. We want to show that nothing is truly forgotten if we look at it with new eyes.
details: Our project helps to find abandoned places and shows how they can be reused. It works with data and maps. We used Canva and coding tools to make it. It will help people to save old places and protect nature
